title: A merge must not erase the evidence of an id collision
intent: Two rows of the first export are proven to be one record by a shared legacy id, and one of them carries raw id 9. The second export also has a record with raw id 9, in its own identity space. Those two records are not proven to be one, and the coincidence has to be reported — reading only the surviving row's id let the merge hide it, which is exactly what the contract says duplicate signals must never do.
